name: article-index-resource-hub
purpose: Every resource of a hub as one ruled list, with a headline and one dropdown per facet (content type, category, industry) on one row that wraps when it runs out of room. Each resource is a row — its cover on the left, and on the right its overline, headline and a two-line deck centred in the row; the row is one link named by its headline, and from `lg` up a read cue rises into its end on hover or keyboard focus. The facets combine; a dropdown with more than seven options gains an option search; a load-more button reveals the next page, and when nothing matches an empty state offers to clear every facet. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'article-index-resource-hub', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `select`, `input`, `empty-state` and `button`; the facet selections, each dropdown's option search and the page count are local state. A row without a cover draws its client's mark in one flat ink that follows the theme.
useWhen: For a resource hub that mixes content types (e-books, posts, comparisons, stories), filtered by facet.
avoidWhen: For the blog's list filtered by a category picker and a search field, with bylines → use `article-index-blog`.
For the success-story library with a card grid → use `story-library`.
related: article-index-blog` — the sibling listing with a category picker and a search field.
story-library` — the card-grid library with search and facets.
bestPractices: Give every item a `facets` entry per facet `key` it can be filtered by; an item without one never matches a selection on that facet.
Keep each facet's `options` to values some item carries.
Set `empty` so a reader who filters everything away gets a way back; without it the list just disappears.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline beside the dropdowns, rendered as the band's `h2`.

props.name: items
props.doc: The resources, in order; each is `{ key, href, image?, mark?, meta, title, description?, facets?, external? }`.

props.name: facets
props.doc: The facet dropdowns, in order; each is `{ key, label, allLabel, options }`.

props.name: rowLabel
props.doc: Read cue revealed at the end of a row under hover or focus.

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Label of the load-more button under the list; without it every match is listed and no button renders.

props.name: pageSize
props.doc: Rows listed per page when `moreLabel` is set; the load-more button reveals the next page.

props.name: leading
props.doc: Leading resources left out until a facet applies, because a band above already shows them.

props.name: empty
props.doc: Copy of the state when nothing matches: `{ title, description?, action? }`; `action` labels a button that resets every facet.

props.name: rowKind
props.doc: Row layout: `centered` centres the copy, `byline` spreads it to the foot of the row.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of resources.

examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ArticleIndexResourceHub from '@aziontech/webkit/article-index-resource-hub'
</script>

<template>
  <ArticleIndexResourceHub
    anchor="resources"
    title="Explore all resources"
    row-label="Read article"
    more-label="Load more"
    aria-label="Resources"
    :facets="[
      {
        key: 'contentType',
        label: 'Content type',
        allLabel: 'All content types',
        options: ['E-books', 'Blog', 'Comparisons']
      },
      {
        key: 'industry',
